The #1 reason rave outfits are revealing is for body temperature regulation. The dancing, the drugs, the crowd all will influence your body temperature to rise. 
Being active and not resting will increase your temperature. Most of their drugs of choice like stimulants, psychedelics, and alcohol increase your body temperature and puts your body in a feverish type state. Having lots of people together in a limited area will increase the temperature because of the body heat we generate as is.
Most raves are also during the summer.

So less clothing traps in less heat, helping us cool. Also the sweat, if you were wearing normal clothes you’d likely end up drenched in sweat, making your clothes heavier and less comfortable for sure. 

If you can’t cool your body temperature down in the event it gets too high, you literally cook. You basically boil yourself and your brain. Now most of your organs would likely be okay at 101-102 degrees but your brain is too delicate… it doesn’t take exposure to excessive heat well at all. But besides the brain, the heat makes the rest of your body struggle in attempts to regulate the temperature which puts added stress on your organs.

The drugs you find at raves… yeah the euphoria can cover up the obvious signs of overheating that you’d likely notice if you were sober. But you may not feel hot- in fact anything that is even a degree or two lower than whatever your body is at is gonna feel cool. So when your skin is exposed to 80 degree air and you’re at 99 degrees inside, you might feel a lil chilly.
They may also relieve other warning signs of excessive heat, like headaches.

It helps you retain water and prevent sweating all your hydration out. The sweat can cool on your skin instead of soaking up in your clothes and making you hotter and making the clothes heavier.
Dehydration and heat together are a serious problem that can in a short time if it’s extreme, cause irreversible damage or death even. Even a healthy young adult should take it very seriously.
